name: Seaside camping
source:
Your solo trip has taken an unexpected turn!

On your way to a mysterious island you meet four handsome fellas, and the rest is history.

"Seaside camping" is a lighthearted linear visual novel about getting stranded on an island with four sexy gay wolves. Simple as that. It is also a prequel of sorts to the main game "[url=https://razor-sharp-6.itch.io/my-wolf-boyfriend]My wolf boyfriend[/url]".

[From [url=https://razor-sharp-6.itch.io/seaside-camping]Itch.io[/url]]
